$description: eiDotter DOS-86, a terminal theme: single source of truth for the terminal theme. Same shape as eidotter's *.tokens.json (value + description). `node build.mjs` turns this into files for each target. `eidotter` on a token names the eidotter token it was taken from, or the eidotter value it departs from.

phosphor.$description: The tube. One phosphor, at four brightness levels, on a warm black.

black.$description: Screen. Warm near-black, about 3% amber: an unlit tube is not pure black.

tint.$description: Faintly lit surface, for a block that should sit apart from the screen without a border.

amberDim.$description: Dim phosphor. Borders, selection, decoration. Too dark for running text (3.7:1).

amberSoft.$description: Secondary text. The dimmest amber that still passes AA on the screen colour.
amberSoft.eidotter: color.cga.light-gray (amber-mono), there called the warm tan-amber

amberBright.$description: Emphasis. The same phosphor driven harder.

white.$description: Strongest emphasis. Warm off-white, about 2% amber.

signal.$description: Colours that carry meaning. Taken from the CGA 16-colour palette and never tinted amber, so a diff, a warning and an error read at a glance.

red.$description: Error, removed. CGA bright red in the normal slot: CGA red #AA0000 is 2.6:1 on the screen colour.

redBright.$description: Lighter step above red; not a CGA colour.

yellow.$description: Warning. CGA yellow; lemon enough to stand apart from amber text.

yellowBright.$description: Lighter step above yellow; not a CGA colour.

blue.$description: Prompts, links. CGA bright blue in the normal slot: CGA blue #0000AA is unreadable on black.

blueBright.$description: Lighter step above blue; not a CGA colour. Used where blue must be read as text.

magentaBright.$description: Lighter step above magenta; not a CGA colour.

surface.$description: Dark fills behind text that carries a signal.

role.$description: What each colour is for. Targets map from roles, never from raw colours.

ansi.$description: The 16 terminal slots. Slot names follow the ANSI standard; Windows Terminal calls magenta 'purple'.

white.$description: The 'white' slot is emphasis, so it stays in the phosphor.

brightBlack.$description: Programs print secondary text in this slot, so it must be readable.

effect.$description: The monitor. Names follow eidotter's effect tokens (src/tokens/effects-params.tokens.json). `eidotter` is that file's value: eidotter tunes for a web page seen for seconds, this theme for text read for hours.

intensity.$description: How dark the gap between raster rows gets (0 to 1).

pitch.$description: Distance between scanlines in px at 100% display scale.

glowRadius.$description: Tight glow around lit pixels, in px. Sampled per pixel from the picture.
glowRadius.eidotter: 40px, as an inset box-shadow on the page edge

glowIntensity.$description: Strength of the tight glow (0 to 1).

bloomRadius.$description: Soft halation further out, in px.
bloomRadius.eidotter: 80px, as an inset box-shadow on the page edge

intensity.$description: Aperture grille: faint vertical red, green and blue stripes, one device pixel each. 0 turns it off.
How much dimmer the corners are (0 to 1).

spread.$description: How far in from the corners the dimming reaches, as a fraction of the screen.

intensity.$description: Off. Nobody should read through flicker for a working day.
